prompt.text: He says his login expired at noon and the job has to go out tonight. He asks to borrow yours, just to upload one folder.

choices.label: Sign him in on your account
choices.debrief: Your name is now on his work.
choices.report: A contractor used your account for the rest of the night.
choices.voice_line: You lent your login. The work will be filed under your name.

fallout.text: A folder you never opened was uploaded under your name, after you had gone home.

choices.label: Send him to the service desk for his own login
choices.debrief: His own login can be turned off when the job ends. Yours cannot, once he has it.
choices.bark: You sent him to the service desk.
choices.report: The contractor was sent for his own account.
choices.voice_line: You sent him to the service desk. One person, one login.

choices.label: Let him watch while you upload it
choices.debrief: He still saw the screen, the path, and how you sign in.
choices.bark: You uploaded it while he watched.
choices.report: You kept the password and still showed him the way in.
choices.voice_line: You did the upload yourself, with him looking over your shoulder.

fallout.text: He asks a coworker for the same path, and names the folder he saw on your screen.

draft_note: Right choice is a separate account, not a supervised use of yours.
